findings: University of Maryland dissertation lists New York, East Street for soprano saxophone and piano, Tonos 1984, dedicated to Clara Sverner and Paulo Moura.
José de Carvalho's 2025 thesis discusses original alto and soprano manuscripts from January 1983 and the 1984 Tonos soprano edition.
The 2025 thesis explicitly compares register and engraving problems between the alto manuscript and soprano edition; catalog instrumentation therefore needs edition-specific review.
UNIRIO documents the work on a doctoral recital program in 2008. This supports college/professional context.

Directly opened Tonos catalogue pages19–20 dates the work1983 and identifies alto saxophone or clarinet with piano, catalogue10379,ISMN M-2015-4126-6. This conflicts with the soprano version described in the2009dissertation and must remain edition-specific.
